name: Greater Enduring Arcana (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Enduring arcana arcana

Benefit: When the magus expends a point from his arcane pool to grant enhancement bonuses or properties to his weapon, the bonuses and properties last for 10 minutes/level.

Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana. Copyright 2011, Super Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
